name: smart-time
title: Time
description: Query timezones, cities, time conversions, relative times, countdowns, and Unix timestamps.
author: alxgsv

commands.name: time
commands.title: Time
commands.subtitle: Timezones, Cities & Conversions
commands.description: Type any timezone (UTC), time conversion (UTC 9am, 9:00 in Tokyo), city (Time in Togliatti), relative math (in 3h, until 18:00), or Unix timestamp.

preferences.name: defaultCities
preferences.title: Default Pinned Locations
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of cities or timezones to show when the search bar is empty
preferences.default: UTC, Togliatti, Moscow, London, New York
